messages.author: ab169084dd463591
messages.subject: Problem with running rdt_happiness model
parts:
Dear hBayesDM users,

I'm trying to run the rdt_happiness model, however, I can't seem to be able to. Even when running it on the example data, I get the following error message: 
"Syntax error in 'string', line 1, column 0, include error:
Could not find include file pre/license.stan in specified include paths."

The piece of code I'm trying to run:
"output_sample <- 
  rdt_happiness(
    data = "example", 
    niter = 4000, 
    nwarmup = 1000,
    nchain = 4, 
    ncore = 4, 
    nthin = 1, # this is the default 
    inits = "vb", 
    indPars = "mean", # this is the default 
    # modelRegressor = FALSE, # not available for this model
    vb = FALSE, # this is the default 
    inc_postpred = FALSE, # this is the default 
    adapt_delta = 0.95, # this is the default 
    stepsize = 1, # this is the default 
    max_treedepth = 15)"

This is particularly strange because I was able to run this exact code on my own data a few weeks ago, and nothing has changed in my setup (R version 4.0.3, hBayesDM version 1.0.2) since then that I'm aware of. 

Any kind of help or suggestion would be greatly appreciated!
Thank you in advance!

Best wishes, 
Timi

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: Problem with running rdt_happiness model
parts:
Hi Timi,

Thanks for reporting it to the mailing list. Could you also report your system (Mac or Windows version)? If you are using the latest Mac OS X (Big Sur), you might check if the command line developer tools are correctly installed. 

And please check if you can run other models (not just the rdt_happiness model) and just double check - check if Stan is correctly installed (see this link). Also try the latest version in GitHub (e.g., for R; https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/tree/develop/R) and see if this works. 

Thanks and please let us know.

Best,
Young
